work.method: Correction in kVAR is kW × (tan(arccos(PF now)) − tan(arccos(PF target))); apparent power is kW ÷ PF; line current is kVA × 1,000 ÷ (√3 × V) for three-phase service. On a tariff that bills demand scaled to a power-factor threshold, billing kW is kW × threshold ÷ PF when PF is lower.
steps: Apparent power: 641 kVA now, 526.3 kVA after; current falls by 138 A at 480 V three-phase.
Tariff: billing demand is 500 kW × 0.9 ÷ 0.78 = 576.9 kW, a power-factor penalty of 76.9 kW, or $1,384.62 a month at $18.00/kW. Correcting to 0.95 removes it.
The saving is the tariff's power-factor effect only; it leaves out the cost of the equipment and its installation, and any reduction in losses.
